# Verint

> > Verint provides CX Automation solutions that combine Conversational AI, Intelligent Virtual Assistants, Agent Copilot, and Workforce Management to transform customer engagement.

Verint delivers enterprise customer experience (CX) automation through the Verint Open Platform, featuring specialized AI bots including Knowledge Automation Bot, Coaching Bot, and Exact Transcription Bot. The company serves industries including retail, banking, and telecommunications with workforce engagement and contact center optimization solutions.

## Key Topics

- CX Automation
- Conversational AI

- Agent Copilot
